snippet.title: Tail of the Sun Japanese Commercial
snippet.description:
Of the many early PS1 games that heavily experimented with the possibilities of 3D, Tail Of The Sun made waves with its ambition and bizarreness. A 'caveman simulator' that can't easily be categorized.

Visit chrislovesjapan.com for more content.

My transcription of the audio:
原始、する。
Wild Pure Simple Life,　太陽のしっぽ
